title: Slow-Cooker Almond Raisin Granola
changes_from_base: Cooked in a slow cooker on high, stirred every hour, instead of in the oven: oats and almonds are coated in an oil, maple, honey and brown sugar syrup with cinnamon, cooled on a tray and mixed with chopped raisins.
summary: A honey-sweetened slow-cooker granola full of almonds and studded with plump raisins, made entirely in one pot without oven baking.

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, for the slow cooker
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Lightly oil the insert of a slow cooker with at least 5000 ml capacity and put in 425 g rolled oats and 285 g almonds roughly chopped.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together 120 ml vegetable oil, 80 ml maple syrup, 113 g runny honey, 66 g light brown sugar, 4 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp ground cinnamon and ½ tsp fine salt.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Tip the whisked mixture over the oats and almonds and stir thoroughly until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Place on the high setting with the lid on and cook for 4-5 h, stirring thoroughly and scraping the sides every hour, until golden and smelling toasty (check from 3 h onwards to prevent scorching).

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Tip onto a rimmed baking tray and leave to cool through, which will help it crisp further.

steps.title: Break
steps.text: Once fully cooled, break into pieces and stir through 285 g raisins roughly chopped.

tips: Use a slow cooker with at least 5000 ml capacity to allow proper circulation and browning
Check after 3 hours to catch the granola before the edges scorch, as slow cookers vary
Stir thoroughly every hour and scrape the sides to encourage even browning throughout
storage: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
